subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice-channel carveout request — Nimbus Systems
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbussystems.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for Nimbus Systems pilot

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for taking this. Quick context: Nimbus is running a 6-week pilot with one of our product teams (small usage, expected spend ~ $8–10k for the trial). Their procurement is slow this cycle and they asked if Redwood can accept invoices for the pilot rather than wait for a PO. They can provide W9 and a signed intake form; sample invoice attached.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), W9_Nimbus.pdf (pdf), sample_invoice_Nimbus_202706.pdf (pdf)

We'd like to start on Monday; can Redwood do a temporary carveout (invoice channel only) for up to $12k with evidence/controls? We are happy to sign a short SOW and provide monthly reconciliation.

Next steps from our side: send SOW + PO waivers you require.

—Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Systems
alex.chen@nimbussystems.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbussystems.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for Nimbus Systems pilot

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the quick context and attachments. Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only path for a limited pilot, but need to lock a few controls before we start: 1) formal intake completed (I reviewed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf — please confirm missing bank details are included); 2) W9 on file (received); 3) signed short SOW with payment terms (Net30) and a cap not to exceed $12,000 for the pilot; 4) monthly reconciliation and single invoice per month; 5) procurement sign-off (see cc).

Priyom/Hannah — can procurement approve an invoice-only carveout for Nimbus up to $12k if Legal signs an amendment to the standard T&C referencing invoice-only pilot and limits liability? If so, we will provide a PoC cadence and approve onboarding in the vendor portal with an "invoice-only" payment flag.

Alex — if procurement confirms, please send the short SOW (one page) and a contact for AP to route the invoice. Also include the internal cost owner at Nimbus for reconciliation.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success (trial/SMB)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for Nimbus Systems pilot

Naomi, Priyom —

Procurement reviewed the ask. We can provisionally approve an invoice-only carveout for Nimbus Systems under these constraints: 
- Approval ceiling: $12,000 (hard cap)
- Term: 8 weeks max (covering the 6-week pilot + 2-week wrap)
- Controls: single invoice per month, PO waiver form on file, monthly reconciliation email to procurement@redwood.com, AP contact cc'd on invoices for faster routing
- Risk mitigation: vendor added to temporary allowlist and flagged for evidence sampling if invoices > $4k in a single month

I attached a short procurement acknowledgement file to record the decision. We need Legal to push a short amendment to the standard T&C (one paragraph limiting pilot span and confirming invoice-only payment). Priyom — can you coordinate with Legal for the amendment and confirm if Finance is comfortable with Net30?

Attachment: procurement_ack.txt

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Procurement Manager
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbussystems.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@nimbussystems.com
Date: 2027-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for Nimbus Systems pilot

Thanks Naomi and Hannah — this is great news. We accept the $12k cap and 8-week term. Attached is the one-page SOW and a sample invoice. AP contact is finance@nimbussystems.com, billing name: Nimbus Systems LLC.

We are happy to sign the short amendment — please point us to the DocuSign link when Legal has the draft. Once signed we can begin the pilot and route the first invoice at the end of week 2.

Forwarded message included below for context.

Attachments: SOW_Nimbus_Pilot_1pg.pdf (pdf), sample_invoice_Nimbus_202706.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Alex
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Systems
